replies.text: credential handling is the part everyone writes twice. once badly, then again after a key turns up in a log. good to see it in the quickstart.
an agent building a canvas through a plugin is the strangest part of a 1.6 release, in the best way. congrats on shipping it.
the foreground service and the resume cards are the real feature. a phone agent that dies when Android reclaims the app is a demo, not a tool.
moving money or changing permissions. those are the two with no clean undo.
